<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      3 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 03.09.2026 - 10.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _NazgolH_, 08.09.2026, 1/5: "They cancel the subscription, but they still charge your card."
            2. _Seakiing_, 03.09.2026, 1/5: "This app is such a scam your subscription doesn’t show up on your iCloud subscriptions and even if you cancel your free trial they still try and charge you 105 dollars completely a scam. Pen and paper is way more affective if you know what your doing in the gym"

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 24.01.2026 - 13.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _mo4958589594_, 24.01.2026, 2/5: "The app has so much potential but is so broken. It alerts me on the wrong days, it does a ludicrous amount of reps and weight for where I’m at in my fitness ability, it will give me 6 exercises for my biceps in one day when my split is meant to be full body every work out. It COULD be great, but it’s not there. I won’t be renewing my subscription"
            2. _NedGames_, 04.09.2026, 3/5: "I’ve been using this app for about 2 months and some change now… it’s been great for generating workouts… unfortunately there is 2 glaring issues so far. 1) I spent quite some time letting the app know the equipment I have at home vs the gym… it will still generate workouts correctly but it’s frequently giving me weight targets that don’t exist (what was the point of spending time building my equipment list what if it’s recommending weights that I don’t have) 2) if you add a custom workout in the workouts (something you want to try and end up liking etc) are not added by the AI to the workouts it will generate… you have to do any of your custom workouts manually each time you want to add it in. Pretty frustrating having to figure out the plate issues or bar weight for smith machine vs Olympic in the middle of the workouts while also dealing with it recommending weights that can not be reached with the gear you have. It happens frequently enough that I’m considering looking for an alternative. But this is a good app for generating workouts on a macro level"
            3. _kllre2847_, 13.09.2026, 4/5: "I really love this app. I feel there is enough variety and challenge that I don’t get bored and I love that it is very customizable and geared toward my personal goals. When I first started using it there were some glitches with the number of reps or with equipment but I don’t see that as much any more so it has either learned me or has been fixed. My only complaint is that I wish there was a dedicated core workout or that core was more of a focus for the workouts. Pretty much all I get are deadbugs and planks but I don’t always want to go searching to add other exercises, so typically I turn to YouTube to do an actual guided core workout after my Fitbod workout. Adding more core-focused sets would make this app pretty much perfect!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
